---
name: project_hsim_cpp_rewrite
description: Building andes-sim, a C++20 multi-engine simulation framework (replaces Python hsim); roadmap at driver/ROADMAP.md
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 0bf4826c-6256-4947-9d43-891b80de273c
---

Ongoing project: replace the Python `hsim` driver with **`andes-sim`**, a single
native **C++20** executable that is a *framework hosting multiple simulator
backends*. Roadmap (15 features F0-F14) lives at **`driver/ROADMAP.md`** - NOT
the repo-root `ROADMAP.md` (master FR tracker, must not be clobbered).

Three concepts (orthogonal): **engine** = a simulator process (qemu,
verilator:<cfg>, future alioth/sid); **model** = how engines compose - `fast`
(QEMU alone), `accurate` (pure Verilator from reset, no QEMU), `hybrid` (QEMU
fast-fwd -> Verilator measures); **trigger** = ROI delimiter under hybrid (csr|
pc|icount|simpoint, the old `--mode` values).

Locked decisions (from the user, this is the CURRENT design - supersedes any
earlier "rewrite hsim CoSIM-ready" framing):
- Binary renamed **`andes-sim`** (hsim name retires). Runtime pure C++; build/test
  infra may stay shell/Python.
- **Plugins are drop-in binaries, not dlopen libs.** Add an engine without
  recompiling andes-sim. Discovery = **scan an engines dir + run `<bin> --describe`**
  -> capability JSON (id/type/kind/vlen/xlen/triggers/roles/state/invoke); sidecar
  `<bin>.json` fallback; built-in descriptor for qemu. `andes-sim list engines` is
  the user-facing query. This is the interface alioth/sid follow + speak
  `hybrid_state_v1` for any role claiming resume/drain. Spec = docs/engine_interface.md.
- **Transparent passthrough for fast/accurate**: parse only selection flags,
  forward everything after `--` verbatim, inherit stdio, NO timeout, propagate exit
  code (exec-style). QEMU can hold gdbstub and wait for a connection. Users see one
  simulator.
- **accurate = pure Verilator from reset, no QEMU.** Already supported: vsim default
  path loads the ELF (`verilator/src/main.cpp:436-437`, load_elf) and runs from
  reset; hybrid is gated by `--resume-from-qemu`. Standalone cycles print to stderr
  ("{} cycles simulated", sc_time_stamp), not a state file.
- `--describe` goes in vsim's optparse next to `--print-config`
  (`verilator/src/main.cpp:189-304`); VLEN available at runtime as `CPU::NDS_VLEN`.
- **No QEMU2 handback** (hybrid cycle figure = vsim mcycle delta; QEMU2 correctness
  still validated by `andes-sim test`). **No CoSIM** (dropped).
- TDD per feature; parity flywheel `tests/andes_sim/parity.sh` (python `hsim.py`
  golden vs `build/andes-sim`) covers carried-over behavior only; new surface
  (fast/accurate/passthrough/list engines) gets fresh acceptance tests.
- `#include include/hybrid/state_abi.h` directly (no offsets). gdbstub C++ headers
  NOT needed (handback dropped).

Related: [[feedback_roadmap_in_repo]] (user reviews task breakdowns as a repo .md).

native **C++20** executable. Roadmap (14 features F0-F13) lives at
**`driver/ROADMAP.md`** - NOT the repo-root `ROADMAP.md`, which is the existing
master FR tracker and must not be clobbered.

Locked decisions (from the user):
- hsim **runtime functionality** must be pure C++ - no Python, no shell on the run
  path. **Build and test infrastructure may stay shell/Python** (`build` shells
  `scripts/build_*.sh`; `test` shells `scripts/run_e2e.sh`).
- **No QEMU2 handback** in the driver (no gdbstub restore). Every mode's cycle
  figure is the vsim `mcycle` delta, so dropping phase 3 is lossless for
  measurement. QEMU2 round-trip correctness stays validated by `hsim test`.
- **CoSIM = lock-step co-verification**, a selectable mode, OFF by default;
  vsim never writes back to QEMU. **Design now, build later** (F13 = spec
  `docs/cosim.md` + stubbed `--mode cosim`, no execution).
- Orchestration core = a loopable **phase-plan engine** (C++ analog of
  `tools/orchestrator/plan.py` Session/Step); each mode is a short plan.
- The driver is standalone: depends only on libc++ + `include/hybrid/state_abi.h`
  (`#include` the struct; mcycle@624, minstret@632, sizeof==3624). The gdbstub
  C++ headers in `verilator/src/hybrid/` are NOT needed (handback dropped); note
  CLAUDE.md's key-files table wrongly lists a `qemu_handback.hpp` that does not exist.
- TDD per feature; flywheel = differential parity harness `tests/hsim/parity.sh`
  diffing `python3 hsim.py` (golden) vs `build/hsim`. Keep Python as reference

**15 features, dependency-ordered:**

| # | Feature | Dep |
|---|---|---|
| F0 | Scaffold + build + parity harness (`andes-sim`) | - |
| F1 | CLI: `--model`/`--engine`/`--trigger` + `--` passthrough split + `list` | F0 |
| **F2** | **Engine registry + `--describe` (plugin system + hot-plug query)** | F1 |
| F3 | `doctor` | F0 |
| F4 | `build` | F0 |
| F5 | Infra: subprocess + passthrough-exec + mmap + state reader | F0 |
| F6 | Phase-plan engine (executor) | F2,F5 |
| F7 | `run --model fast` (QEMU-only, passthrough) | F5,F2 |
| F8 | `run --model accurate` (pure Verilator, passthrough) | F7,F2 |
| F9 | `run --model hybrid` (csr\|pc\|icount) | F6 |
| F10 | `profile` + `cluster` | F5 |
| F11 | `run --model hybrid --trigger simpoint` + `estimate` | F9,F10 |
| F12 | `test` | F5 |
| F13 | `archive` + `replay` | F5,F9 |
| F14 | Swap to `andes-sim` + docs | all |

**Critical path is the spine** `F0 -> F1 -> F2`. F2 is the heart of your ask: scan engines dir, run `<bin> --describe`, parse the capability JSON, `list engines`. It also adds `--describe` to vsim and writes `docs/engine_interface.md` - the contract alioth/sid follow.

**What grounding the code changed:**
- `accurate` shrank to a near-trivial feature - vsim **already** runs standalone from reset (`main.cpp:436-437`); F8 just invokes it without `--resume-from-qemu` and lets its native cycle line through. No boot path to build.
- The hot-plug question is settled by `--describe`: runtime discovery = **scan + self-describe**, so a dropped-in `sim_<cfg>` appears with zero `andes-sim` rebuild and zero hand-written manifest.
- `--describe` has a clean home next to vsim's existing `--print-config`.

One decision I made for you (say if you disagree): kept the roadmap at `driver/ROADMAP.md` and rewrote it in place rather than spawning a second roadmap file - the source dir stays `driver/`, the binary is `build/andes-sim`.

Ready to start F0 when you give the word.
